chunk.content: Goldband goatfish reach 22.5 cm TL (common length 18 cm TL); they form large schools in coastal waters with a muddy substrate and usually swim fast with short stops to feed.
chunk.source_quote: Found in coastal waters with a muddy substrate. Forms large schools ... Usually fast swimming with short stops to feed ... Max length: 22.5 cm TL ... common length: 18.0 cm TL
